paper.title: On Frequentist Regret of Linear Thompson Sampling

settings.name_in_paper: Example 1: Noise reduction and changing action sets
unmapped: Gaussian noise N(0,tau^2) and Gaussian prior N(0,sigma^2 I_{2d}) that are mismatched with LinTS's assumed unit noise/prior variance (sigma != tau)
dimension 2d; action sets constructed in advance independent of history
settings.definition_quote: Let $d$ be a positive integer and define $\Param\sim\Prior=\Normal{0,\sigma^2\II_{2d}}$. We will construct a $2d$-dimensional linear bandit setting where in the first $3d$ rounds, the action sets of the type introduced above ... are presented to the algorithm.

settings.name_in_paper: Example 2: Mean shift and fixed action sets
unmapped: Prior N(mu 1_{3d}, sigma^2 I_{3d}) (mean shift) or N(0, sigma^2 I + rho 11^T) mismatched with LinTS's assumed standard normal prior
fixed action set {0, A', A} of three actions in R^{3d}
settings.definition_quote: Let $\mu,\sigma,\tau>0$ be fixed, and for $d\in\IN$, set the prior distribution to be $\Prior:=\Normal{\mu\One_{3d},\sigma^2\II_{3d}}$. We now reveal the action set $\ArmSet_t:=\{0, \Arm', \Arm\}$ to \LinTS{} for all $t\in[T]$

settings.name_in_paper: Stochastic linear bandit with changing action sets (under Assumptions 1-2)
unmapped: Assumption 1 (optimal arm diversity with parameter nu) and Assumption 2 (random-friendly optimal arm with parameters Psi, omega)
settings.definition_quote: Let $(\ArmSet_t)_{t=1}^T$ be a sequence of $T$ random compact subsets of $\IR^d$ ... We further assume that $\Norm{\Arm}_2\leq\ArmBound$ ... receives a stochastic reward $\RewardValue_t=\Inner[\big]{\Param,\ChosenArm_t}+\eps_t$

algorithms.name: Linear Thompson Sampling (LinTS) with inflation iota

symbols.rho: confidence radius: optimism condition holds whenever ||hat theta_t - theta||_{Sigma_t^{-1}} <= rho
symbols.p_opt: lower bound on conditional probability of optimism

extra_assumptions: LinTS satisfies optimism probability >= p whenever ||hat theta_t - theta||_{Sigma_t^{-1}} <= rho

source.label: thm:expected-regret-bound
source.quote: If \cref{alg:proper-ts} satisfies \Prob{\sup_{A}\Inner{A,\TsSample_t} \geq \sup_A\Inner{A,\Param} | \Param,\HistoryPlus_t}\geq p, whenever $\Norm{\Estimator_t-\Param}_{\SymCovMatrix_t^{-1}}\leq\Radius$, we then have $\Regret(T,\PolicyTS)\leq\OrderLog*{\frac{\Radius\Inflation}{\OptProb}\sqrt{\Dim T}}$.

results.notes: Regret defined as Bayesian (frequentist via point-mass prior). Conditional sufficient-condition result.

extra_assumptions: applies to LinTS with iota=1, lambda=1 (no inflation, assumes unit prior and noise variance)
true prior variance sigma^2 differs from noise variance tau^2

source.label: prop:noise-reduction-failure
source.quote: In Example 1, when $\sigma\neq\tau$ and $T\leq\exp(\LowerOrder{d})$, we have $\Regret(T,\PolicyTS)\geq\LowerOrder{T}$.

results.notes: Algorithm-specific lower bound for un-inflated LinTS (a1).

source.label: cor:noise-reduction-failure
source.quote: In Example 1, when $d=\LowerOrder{\log T}$ and $\sigma\neq\tau$, we have $\Regret(T,\PolicyTS)\geq\LowerOrder{T}$.

results.notes: Lower bound specific to un-inflated LinTS.

bound.regime: fixed mu, sigma > 0, d sufficiently large, T <= exp(Omega(d))

extra_assumptions: LinTS with iota=1 assuming standard normal prior and noise; true prior N(mu 1, sigma^2 I)
results.notes: Rewards scale with sqrt(d) in this example (means of order mu sqrt d).

source.label: cor:mean-shift-failure
source.quote: In Example 2, when $d=\LowerOrder{\log T}$ and the true prior $\Prior$ is either $\Normal{\mu\One_{3d},\sigma^2\II_{3d}}$ or $\Prior=\Normal{0,\sigma^2\II_{3d}+\rho\One_{3d}\One_{3d}^\top}$, we have $\Regret(T,\PolicyTS)\geq\LowerOrder{T}$.

results.notes: Lower bound specific to un-inflated LinTS.

source.label: thm:lin-ts-regret
source.quote: Let $\Worth_t(\cdot)$ be optimistic with parameter $\OptProb$ whenever $\ITypical_t=1$, $\ITypicalM_t=1$, and $\IWellPosed_t=1$. When \cref{as:optimal-diversity,as:optimal-random-friendly} hold, and $\Inner{\Arm,\Param}\in[-1,1]$ ... we have that \sum_t ... \leq \frac{4(\RadiusParam+\RadiusWorth)\sqrt T}{\OptProb}(...)+2\sum_{t}\Indicator(\Thinness(\SymCovMatrix_t)>\ThinnessBound), with probability at least $1-\frac3T$.

results.notes: Bound on realized pseudo-regret (sum of mean gaps) w.h.p.; depends on data-dependent thinness count.
